title: Open-Throat Desktop Stapler
description: One original low-poly desktop stapler visual prop for office and school scenes. A full rubber-style sole supports a low bevel-profile base, with a real grooved clincher anvil at the front and an integral raised transverse rear hinge cradle. A long tapered blue upper shell rests on that cradle; a one-piece thick U-section steel-style magazine has a genuine open front and complete interior staple channel above a wide empty throat. Six closed separately editable meshes, four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. One whole prop, zero scenes. Metres, Z up, front -Y, ground Z=0. Geometry authored specifically for this object; no previous tool or office assembly imported.
